# Luxury Jeweleris

> Exquisite Handcrafted Fine Jewelry, Custom Diamond Engagement Rings, and Ethically Sourced Gemstones.

## Core Offerings
- Engagement Rings: Solitaire, Halo, Pavé, Three-Stone, Hidden Halo (Natural & Lab-Grown Diamonds)
- Wedding Bands: Platinum, 14k/18k Yellow, Rose & White Gold
- Physical Boutiques: Santa Anita Mall (Arcadia, CA), Topanga Westfield (Canoga Park, CA)
- Customer Promise: GIA/IGI Certification, 30-Day Returns, Free Insured Shipping
